name: ConceptViz
description_en:
ConceptViz is an AI visual-creation service for illustrations, flowcharts and data figures. Users describe a visual, review a generation plan and refine versions through conversation. Its current scope is broader than traditional mind mapping.

Agent work allowance, image-generation credits and editable export charges are separate resources. Output use rights also differ between free and qualifying paid accounts.
description_zh:
ConceptViz 是创建插图、流程图和数据图形的 AI 服务。用户描述图形、审核生成方案，并通过对话修改版本，当前范围比传统脑图更广。

Agent 工作额度、图片生成 credits 和可编辑导出费用是独立资源；免费与符合条件付费账户的产出使用权也不同。

sections.title_en: Plan, generate and revise a visual
sections.en: The homepage describes choosing illustration, flowchart or data-chart output and asking for edits. It says the Agent shows a prompt/settings plan before generation, with credit spent when Generate is pressed, and keeps prior versions. PNG/JPG downloads differ from editable SVG/PPTX exports. A visually coherent scientific figure is not proof that its labels or relationships are correct.
sections.zh: 首页介绍插图、流程图或数据图表输出及自然语言修改，说明 Agent 在生成前展示提示和设置方案，点击 Generate 才消耗额度，并保留旧版本。PNG/JPG 下载与可编辑 SVG/PPTX 不同。科学图形看起来连贯，并不证明标签和关系正确。

sections.title_zh: 示例：解释订单履约流程
sections.en: Provide the actual order states and exception paths, review the proposed diagram and generate a first version. Check arrow direction, missing rejection paths and labels before requesting a layout edit. For a chart, compare values and units with the supplied data rather than approving appearance alone. Download an editable export only if its structure is suitable for subsequent work. No figure or export was generated here.
sections.zh: 提供实际订单状态及异常路径，审核方案后生成首版。请求布局修改前，应检查箭头方向、缺失拒绝路径和标签。数据图还需与输入核对数值及单位，不能只看外观。需要后续编辑时，应确认导出结构适用。本文未生成或导出图形。

sections.title_en: Two resource pools and charged exports
sections.title_zh: 两类资源池及收费导出
sections.en: The free start gives two image credits valid for seven days plus a small Agent trial allowance. The annual Standard view lists $249.90/year with 45 monthly image credits; Pro $829.90/year with 130; Max $1,499.90/year with 220. Agent work allowance is separate. SVG export costs two credits; PPTX costs four and requires Pro/Max. Allowance top-ups do not include image credits or unlock higher-plan functions; Studio image packs do not include Agent work or editable exports.
sections.zh: 免费开始提供有效七天的两个图片 credits 及少量 Agent 试用额度。年付 Standard 列每年 249.90 美元、每月 45 图片 credits；Pro 829.90 美元、130；Max 1,499.90 美元、220。Agent 工作额度另计。SVG 每次两 credits，PPTX 四 credits 且需 Pro/Max。工作额度加购不含图片 credits，也不解锁更高版功能；Studio 图片包不含 Agent 工作或可编辑导出。

sections.title_en: Free output is not commercially unrestricted
sections.title_zh: 免费产出不能无限商用
sections.en: The license page restricts free-account output to stated personal/classroom uses and retains a watermark. Qualifying paid accounts receive commercial-use permission for eligible generated diagrams, subject to the terms and content rules; this is not a source-code license. It distinguishes education discounts from grandfathered grants, and individual rights from organization-wide rights. Verify the account and purchase status before using an image in paid material.
sections.zh: 许可页把免费产出限制在规定个人及课堂用途并保留水印。符合条件付费账户可按条款及内容规则商用相应生成图，这不是源码许可。页面区分教育折扣与既有补助，也区分个人和组织权利。用于收费材料前需确认账户及购买状态。

sections.title_en: Use it with subject and data review
sections.title_zh: 结合主题及数据审核使用
sections.en: Start with a public, bounded brief and verify a small output before uploading documents. ConceptViz may fit explanatory figure drafting; a task requiring exact native mind-map nodes or reproducible statistical plotting needs separate compatibility checks. Generated accuracy, edit fidelity, confidential-data handling, restoration and service-source licensing were not tested or established here.
sections.zh: 先用公开且范围明确的需求验证小型输出，再考虑上传文档。它可能适合解释图草稿；需要精确原生脑图节点或可复现统计绘图的任务应另查兼容性。生成准确性、修改保真、保密数据处理、恢复和服务源码许可未测试或确认。
